mapper.select: SELECT column_name, column_comment, column_type, (CASE WHEN column_key = 'PRI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_pk, (CASE WHEN is_nullable = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_required, (CASE WHEN extra = 'auto_increment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_increment, ordinal_position AS sort FROM information_schema.COLUMNS WHERE table_name = (SELECT table_name FROM gen_table WHERE id = #{genTableId}) AND table_schema = DATABASE() ORDER BY ordinal_position
